dct_description_sm: These data collected during a survey whose main purpose was to describe ice formation, thickness and circulation in areas adjacent to the estuary of the Nelson River, and the extent, thickness and water quality parameters of the under-ice plume of the Nelson and Hayes River.  This expedition was a partnership between ArcticNet and Manitoba Hydro, bu only ArcticNet data are described here. However there exists a complementary dataset, included additional under-ice CTD (conductivity-temperature-depth) data, ADCP (acoustic doppler current profiler) data and data from fixed moorings that are the property of Manitoba Hydro.
dct_subject_sm: Natural sciences -> Colored dissolved organic material (CDOM)
dct_title_s: Winter survey of the Nelson River estuary in Hudson Bay, 2009
